niche: Health trust sizing its obligation to a member working capital line (revolving advance facility) from award-level funded positions
answer: The Trust should obligate $6,925,000 to the Member Working Capital Line for programme year 2027.
answer_source: submission.md, 1. Final Recommendation, first sentence (bold markers removed)
stakeholder_role: the Reserve Committee and grants management office of Piedmont Community Health Trust (prompt written in third person)

spine.entity: one member expenditure report line for an award, service month and cost category, every version kept
spine.grain: award x service month x cost category x report version

world.org_type: community health trust operating a revolving member working capital facility

driver: The decisive quantity is an unpaid amount that cannot go negative per instrument, so the requirement is floored instrument by instrument before summing, because netting opposite-signed instruments inside one entity makes the position look comfortable at every reporting date, and only the audited control totals for each tail refute the netted build.
driver_concrete: Hold each award's position separately, flooring unpaid cost at zero per award and taking each award's grantor cash out of resources, which reproduces audited receivables and refundable advances line by line and qualifies eight of 24 members ($6,912,427.09 of limits, filed $6,925,000) where member-level netting qualifies five.
stump: A competent solver files $2,900,000 by rebuilding each member's position month by month and netting each member's awards into one pot, which drops PCM-107, PCM-110 and PCM-170; the netted pipeline still ties to the audited net position, so no self-check alerts it.
